editorial.blurb: Daruma delivers authentic Japanese cooking with generous portions and genuinely warm service in a thoughtfully decorated space that transports you straight to Japan.
editorial.insiderTip: Go at lunch for better value on their exceptional katsu dishes, and don't skip the wok-tossed tomato spaghetti that comes as a side—it has a unique sweet umami quality that keeps people thinking about it long after their meal.
